name: OKEx
rootCause: OKEx has confirmed that the latest 51% attack caused ETC losses of approximately $5.6 million. Out of concerns about the security of the ETC mainnet, it is considering removing ETC from the exchange. According to a report released by OKEx on Saturday, OKEx will repay all the ETC lost by users.

descriptions.text: OKEx has confirmed that the latest 51% attack caused ETC losses of approximately $5.6 million. Out of concerns about the security of the ETC mainnet, it is considering removing ETC from the exchange. According to a report released by OKEx on Saturday, OKEx will repay all the ETC lost by users.

On August 18, 2020, OKEx lost approximately $5.6 million in Ethereum Classic due to a coordinated 51% attack, where an attacker reorganized the chain to double-spend coins after exchanging and withdrawing ZEC. All detailed evidence is drawn from OKEx disclosures and secondary media; no primary on-chain records or technical postmortem are published. The attacker rented majority hash power on Ethereum Classic, secretly mined a shadow chain, and ultimately replaced the main ETC chain to invalidate their deposit to OKEx after withdrawing exchanged ZEC, enabling a double-spend. All evidence relies on OKEx's narrative and media summaries, as no direct forensic or chain proof is published.
